title: PostReady: PR #503 — Swap landing wordmark to the rocket lockup
description: Replaced the lightning-bolt ZippityOne wordmark with the new rocket speech-bubble lockup on the landing page. Cropped tight from marketing render to match original aspect ratio with transparent background. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #501 — Shotstack: render reframed clips at quality:high
description: Upgraded Shotstack renders for reframed video clips to quality:high, improving output fidelity when per-platform crops are applied at publish time. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #499 — Video upload: clear message when clip exceeds 500MB
description: Added a clear user-facing error message when a video upload exceeds the 500MB limit, preventing silent failures and improving the upload UX. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #498 — Video reframe Phase 2b: per-platform crop at publish via Shotstack
description: Reframe offsets are now applied at publish time via Shotstack, so each platform receives a properly cropped video without manual export steps. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #497 — Fix TikTok frequent reconnect: single-flight token refresh (reuse X lock)
description: Applied the same single-flight token refresh pattern from PR #496 to TikTok, reusing the X rotation lock to prevent concurrent reconnect races on TikTok as well. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #496 — Fix X frequent reconnect: single-flight token refresh (rotation race)
description: Fixed a race condition in X/Twitter token rotation that caused frequent reconnect cycles. Applied single-flight pattern to the token refresh so concurrent requests share one refresh instead of racing. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #495 — Video reframe Phase 2a: persist per-platform offsets on save
description: Reframe offsets now persist per-platform when saved, so users framing choices are remembered across sessions. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #494 — Auto-caption videos by captioning an extracted frame
description: Video uploads now auto-generate captions using vision on an extracted frame, reducing manual caption entry for uploaded video content. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #493 — Video reframe: pause/play, scrub bar, copy-framing-to-all
description: Added pause/play controls with auto-pause on drag, a scrub bar for navigating video frames, and a copy-framing-to-all button for efficient multi-platform setup. Merged Jul 12.

title: PostReady: PR #492 — Length coach: redirect long-form videos to YouTube
description: Added a length coach that detects long-form video uploads and guides users toward YouTube, reinforcing that ZippityOne is short-form first. Merged Jul 12.
